claims.claim: Positive state-independent scalar Gaussian convolution and all quadrature marginals for the canonical Q,P pair

claims.boundary: Special unbounded canonical pair; does not establish arbitrary bounded-tuple universality or the exact Pauli variance gap.

claims.claim: The all-linear-marginal Wigner distribution and characteristic exp(i t dot A)
claims.boundary: Not a new representation principle; unsmoothed distribution generally is not positive.

claims.claim: A single vector-valued spin POVM is projected along every direction
claims.boundary: Earlier all-direction work exists. Its noise/postprocessing contract is weaker than a single state-independent scalar convolution.

claims.claim: Covariant qubit measurement plus independent classical radius
claims.boundary: A special radius can implement an additional exact Fourier identity without creating a new underlying quantum-information channel.

claims.claim: The ordinary unbiased report 3n has per-coordinate added variance 2
claims.boundary: This report fails the exact scalar contract at k=pi/2. Its optimality under weaker criteria cannot establish the optimum here.

claims.claim: General joint-measurement moment positivity implies tr Sigma >= 6
claims.boundary: Independent Bloch-density Cauchy-Schwarz proof in PRIOR_ART.md; no novelty claim.

claims.claim: The 2025 generalized Husimi Pauli model already satisfies exact scalar convolution
claims.evidence: Its first moment is [(3+2 tau)/(3(1+2 tau))] sigma_j, while any scalar convolution gives sigma_j + mu_j I.
claims.boundary: The qubit normalization is state-independent. The exclusion uses the actual kernel/first moment, not a false assertion of state-dependent qubit normalization.

claims.boundary: The underlying Dickman law and covariant measurement are classical/established; novelty of this precise coupling and transform identity remains uncleared.
